content.text: {"catalog":{"METADATA":[{"name":"get_object_metadata","description":"List object metadata as an array. Filter to a single object by id or objectName (singular or plural). Set includeFields to also return each object's fields ({id, name, type, label}) — enough to build a dashboard or view without a separate get_field_metadata call. System objects are otherwise returned as compact {id, nameSingular, namePlural}. Keep includeFullSystemObjects at its default (false); only set it true when you specifically need a system object's full configuration."},{"name":"create_object_metadata","description":"Create a new object in the workspace data model."},{"name":"update_object_metadata","description":"Update an object. Provide object ID and properties to change."},{"name":"delete_object_metadata","description":"Delete an object by ID. Also deletes associated fields."},{"name":"create_many_object_metadata","description":"Create multiple objects at once. Batch version of create_object_metadata."},{"name":"update_many_object_metadata","description":"Update multiple objects at once. Batch version of update_object_metadata."},{"name":"get_field_metadata","description":"Returns an array of fields. System fields are returned as compact {id, name, type} — enough to know which fields exist and their types. Keep includeFullSystemFields at its default (false); only set it true when you specifically need a system field's full configuration (settings, defaultValue, relation targets). Internal fields (searchVector, position, updatedBy) are excluded."},{"name":"create_field_metadata","description":"Create a new field on an object."},{"name":"update_field_metadata","description":"Update a field. Provide field ID and properties to change."},{"name":"delete_field_metadata","description":"Delete a field by ID."},{"name":"create_many_field_metadata","description":"Create multiple field metadata at once on one or more objects. More efficient than calling create_field_metadata multiple times. Each item follows the same schema as create_field_metadata."},{"name":"update_many_field_metadata","description":"Update multiple field metadata at once. More efficient than calling update_field_metadata multiple times. Each item must include the field ID and the properties to update."},{"name":"create_many_relation_fields","description":"Create multiple relation fields between objects at once."}]},"message":"Found 13 tool(s) across 1 category(ies)."}
